facts.claim: The Mysore State Railway from Bangalore to Mysore was completed as far as Mandya by March 1881.
facts.quote: the Mysore State Railway, from Bangalore to Mysore, completed as far as Mandya, 58 miles on the metre gauge.

facts.claim: The railway line from Bangalore to Tumkur was opened for traffic in August 1884.
facts.quote: In October 1882, the line from Bangalore to Tumkur, 43 miles of metre gauge, was commenced, a loan of 20 lakhs at 5 per cent, interest having been raised for the pur- pose, and was opened for traffic in August 1S84.

facts.claim: A further portion of the railway line to Gubbi, measuring 11 miles, was opened in December 1884.
facts.quote: A further portion to Gubbi, II miles, was opened in December 1884.
